children: STOXX SUBDUED AS MORE RATE HIKES LOOM

edged lower in morning trade on Monday as concerns about a slowdown in AI development, coupled with looming interest rate hikes in the U.S. this week, alongside rising oil prices, weighed on global markets.

The pan-European index was down around 0.1%, holding above the two-month low hit last week after the European Central Bank increased borrowing costs and warned of higher inflation due to a war-driven energy shock.
Losses in chipmakers made tech (.SX8P) the biggest sectoral drag in the region, with the index falling more than 1% to a fresh six-week low.
Gains elsewhere helped limit the fall, however, with around 300 STOXX constituents trading higher and 60 little changed. Advances were concentrated in software, healthcare and energy.
